tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page, slide and chart ground. Light is Parchment, the site's page; dark is the site's dark page and the slide sheet.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, table rows, tooltips and code blocks sitting on `surface`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Light tile for a published figure on a dark slide (light theme: white). Text on it is `on-panel`.

tokens.name: on-panel
tokens.usage: Text on `panel`. 14:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Light is the brand's warm near-black ink.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, axis titles and citations on `surface` and `surface-raised`. Light is darkened from the brand's slate-mid to reach 5:1; dark is the brand's dark-mode body text.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholder and disabled text, and decoration. The light value is the brand's slate-mid, only 3.3:1 on parchment, so never use it for text that must be read.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers (the brand's stone). Not for anything that must be seen on its own; use `border-strong`.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, axis lines and table outlines. At least 3:1 on `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: grid-fine
tokens.usage: Default chart gridline: a light blue, after OS maps and graph paper. Draw major lines at 1px and minor (log-axis) lines at 0.5px. Decorative, so keep every value labelled on the axis.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Loch Teal: links, active navigation, headings accents, primary buttons. The dark value is the brand's lightened teal.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on `primary` fills.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Highland Rust: emphasis and danger. The dark value is a lightened rust made for this system (the brand's #962C26 is 2.3:1 on the dark page).

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary` fills.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Hyperlinks: teal on light, the established lavender on dark.

tokens.name: link-visited
tokens.usage: Visited links. Dark value is 4.8:1 on `surface` but 4.2:1 on `surface-raised`; keep visited links off raised cards.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px, at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: tan
tokens.usage: Warm tan from the brand's extended palette: tags and the earth tone beside terrain.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Rust red from the extended palette: badges and warnings that are not links.

tokens.name: teal-bright
tokens.usage: Bright teal: success badges.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Magenta: tags. Also the hill-route magenta family on maps.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Lime: highlights on dark only.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Lavender purple: tags, and the hue behind the dark-mode link.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Sky blue: soft fills.

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Ice blue: information badges.

tokens.name: ocean
tokens.usage: Ocean deep: dark teal fills and the deepest map water.

tokens.name: cat-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1 (gold; the 'SNP' hue). Series run cat-1 to cat-6 in order. Colour never works alone: add direct labels, marker shapes or a table; the light gold is only 1.9:1 on parchment.

tokens.name: cat-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2 (blue).

tokens.name: cat-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3 (orange).

tokens.name: cat-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4 (indigo).

tokens.name: cat-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5 (green).

tokens.name: cat-6
tokens.usage: Categorical series 6 (red).

tokens.name: cat-other
tokens.usage: The 'other' or unassigned series, always last.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The brand's gold (cat-1) by name, for fills and highlights outside a series.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The brand's blue (cat-2) by name, for fills and highlights outside a series.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: The brand's orange (cat-3) by name, for fills and highlights outside a series.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: The brand's indigo (cat-4) by name, for fills and highlights outside a series.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The brand's green (cat-5) by name, for fills and highlights outside a series.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: The brand's red (cat-6) by name, for fills and highlights outside a series.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: Reference lines, priors, 'everything else'.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on `gold` fills.

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text on `blue` fills. Large text only on light (4.4:1).

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Text on `orange` fills.

tokens.name: on-indigo
tokens.usage: Text on `indigo` fills.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text on `green` fills.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text on `red` fills. Large text only on light (4.1:1).

tokens.usage: Observing run O1 in every chart and legend.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp, low to high, single blue hue. Steps differ by at least 1.3:1 in lightness. Light theme runs light to dark and dark theme runs dark to light, so 'more' is always more visible against `surface`.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 2 of 6.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 3 of 6.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 4 of 6.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 5 of 6.

tokens.name: seq-6
tokens.usage: Sequential ramp step 6 of 6.

tokens.name: terrain-1
tokens.usage: Terrain ramp sampled from the map's topology tiles (hillshade cream to shadow brown). Use for elevation, density on maps and anything read as relief. Label the scale.

tokens.name: terrain-2
tokens.usage: Terrain ramp step 2 of 6.

tokens.name: terrain-3
tokens.usage: Terrain ramp step 3 of 6.

tokens.name: terrain-4
tokens.usage: Terrain ramp step 4 of 6.

tokens.name: terrain-5
tokens.usage: Terrain ramp step 5 of 6.

tokens.name: terrain-6
tokens.usage: Terrain ramp step 6 of 6.

tokens.name: div-neg2
tokens.usage: Diverging ramp: blue (negative) through a neutral to red (positive); zero is `div-mid`. Use only for a quantity with a meaningful zero.

tokens.name: div-neg1
tokens.usage: Diverging ramp step.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging ramp step.

tokens.name: div-pos1
tokens.usage: Diverging ramp step.

tokens.name: div-pos2
tokens.usage: Diverging ramp step.
